question: To what kind of person must this teaching be given after a test lasting one year?
premises: The teaching is marked as something to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
